sentences.zh: 推天正十一月經朔加時入交：置天正十一月朔積分，以交終分秒去之，不盡，滿樞法為日，不滿為餘秒，即天正經朔加時入交泛日及餘秒。

translations.literal: To find the civil eleventh-month mean new-moon hour entry into convergence: set the civil eleventh-month new-moon accumulated parts; remove by the convergence termination parts and seconds; what does not exhaust, when it fills the pivot factor counts as days and what does not fill counts as remainder seconds — that is the civil mean new-moon hour general convergence day and remainder seconds.
translations.idiomatic: To find the civil eleventh-month mean new-moon hour entry into convergence: set the civil eleventh-month new-moon accumulated parts, discard full convergence termination parts and seconds, divide the remainder by the pivot factor for days and remainder seconds, and obtain the civil mean new-moon hour general convergence day and remainder seconds.

sentences.zh: 求次朔及望入交：因天正經朔加時入交泛日及餘秒，求次朔，以朔差日及餘秒加之；

translations.literal: To find the next new moon and full moon entry into convergence: take the civil mean new-moon hour general convergence day and remainder seconds; to find the next new moon, add the new-moon difference day and remainder seconds;
translations.idiomatic: To find the next new moon and full moon entry into convergence: starting from the civil mean new-moon hour general convergence day and remainder seconds, add the new-moon difference day and remainder seconds to obtain the next new moon;

sentences.zh: 求望，以望策及餘秒加之：滿交終日及餘秒皆去之，即次朔及望加時所入。

translations.literal: to find the full moon, add the full-moon increment and remainder seconds: when it fills the convergence termination day and remainder seconds, remove all — that is what the next new moon and full moon hour entries enter.
translations.idiomatic: to find the full moon, add the full-moon increment and remainder seconds; when the total fills a convergence termination day and remainder seconds, discard the full period — that yields the hour entries for the next new moon and full moon.

sentences.zh: 若以經朔、望小餘減之，即各得朔、望夜半入交泛日及餘秒。

translations.literal: If one subtracts by the mean new- or full-moon minor remainders, each obtains the new- or full-moon midnight general convergence day and remainder seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract the mean new- or full-moon minor remainders to obtain the midnight general convergence day and remainder seconds for each new moon and full moon.

sentences.zh: 求定朔夜半入交：因經朔、望夜半入交，若定朔、望大餘有進退者，亦進退交日，不則因經為定，各得所求。

translations.literal: To find the fixed new-moon midnight entry into convergence: follow the mean new- or full-moon midnight entry into convergence; if the fixed new- or full-moon major remainder has advance or retreat, advance or retreat the convergence day as well; otherwise take the mean as fixed — each obtains what is sought.
translations.idiomatic: To find the fixed new-moon midnight entry into convergence: follow the mean new- or full-moon midnight entry; if the fixed new- or full-moon major remainder advances or retreats, advance or retreat the convergence day accordingly; otherwise treat the mean value as fixed — each procedure yields the desired result.

sentences.zh: 求次定朔夜半入交：各因前定朔夜半入交，大月加日二，小月加日一，餘皆加八千三百四十二、秒五千七百二十三；

translations.literal: To find the next fixed new-moon midnight entry into convergence: each follows the previous fixed new-moon midnight entry into convergence; for a long month add 2 days, for a short month add 1 day, and to all remainders add 8,342 and seconds 5,723;
translations.idiomatic: To find the next fixed new-moon midnight entry into convergence: take the previous fixed new-moon midnight entry; for a long month add 2 days, for a short month add 1 day, and to every remainder add 8,342 parts and 5,723 seconds;

sentences.zh: 若求次日，累加一日：滿交終日及餘秒皆去之，即得次定朔及每日夜半入交泛日及餘秒。

translations.literal: if seeking the next day, accumulate by adding one day: when it fills the convergence termination day and remainder seconds, remove all — thereby obtaining the next fixed new moon and each day's midnight general convergence day and remainder seconds.
translations.idiomatic: to find the following day, add one day repeatedly; when the total fills a convergence termination day and remainder seconds, discard the full period — thereby obtaining the next fixed new moon and the general convergence day and remainder seconds for each day's midnight.

sentences.zh: 求朔望加時入交常日：置經朔、望入交泛日及餘秒，以其朔、望入氣朏朒定數，朏減朒加之，即朔、望入交常日及餘秒。

translations.literal: To find the new- or full-moon hour regular convergence day: set the mean new- or full-moon general convergence day and remainder seconds; with that new- or full-moon's qi-entry waxing-waning fixed number, subtract for waning and add for waxing — that is the new- or full-moon regular convergence day and remainder seconds.
translations.idiomatic: To find the new- or full-moon hour regular convergence day: set the mean new- or full-moon general convergence day and remainder seconds, apply that syzygy's qi-entry waxing-waning correction (subtract when waning, add when waxing), and obtain the regular convergence day and remainder seconds.

sentences.zh: 求朔望加時入交定日：置其朔、望入轉朏朒定數，以交率乘之，如交數而一，所得，以朏減朒加入交常日余，滿若不足，進退其日，即朔、望加時入交定日及餘秒。

translations.literal: To find the new- or full-moon hour fixed convergence day: set that new- or full-moon's rotation waxing-waning fixed number; multiply by the convergence ratio and divide by the convergence number for one; what is obtained, subtract for waning and add for waxing to the regular convergence day remainder; if it fills or falls short, advance or retreat the day — that is the new- or full-moon hour fixed convergence day and remainder seconds.
translations.idiomatic: To find the new- or full-moon hour fixed convergence day: take that syzygy's rotation waxing-waning fixed number, multiply by the convergence ratio and divide by the convergence number, apply the result to the regular convergence remainder (subtract when waning, add when waxing), and advance or retreat the day if the total overflows or falls short — thereby obtaining the fixed convergence day and remainder seconds.

sentences.zh: 求月行入陰陽曆：視其朔、望入交定日及餘秒，在中日及餘秒以下者為月在陽曆；

translations.literal: To find the moon's motion entry into the yin-yang calendars: observe its new- or full-moon fixed convergence day and remainder seconds; what is at or below the middle day and remainder seconds means the moon is in the yang calendar;
translations.idiomatic: To find the moon's entry into the yin and yang calendars: inspect the syzygy's fixed convergence day and remainder seconds; if it is at or below the middle day and remainder seconds, the moon is in the yang calendar;

sentences.zh: 如中日及餘秒已上者，減去之，為月在陰曆。

translations.literal: what is at or above the middle day and remainder seconds, subtract it — the moon is in the yin calendar.
translations.idiomatic: if it is at or above the middle day and remainder seconds, subtract the middle day and remainder — the moon is in the yin calendar.

sentences.zh: 凡入交定日，陽初陰末為交初，陰初陽末為交中。

translations.literal: Whenever entering a fixed convergence day, yang beginning and yin end is convergence beginning; yin beginning and yang end is convergence middle.
translations.idiomatic: For any fixed convergence day, yang at the beginning and yin at the end marks convergence beginning; yin at the beginning and yang at the end marks convergence middle.

sentences.zh: 求朔望加時月入陰陽曆積度：置其月入陰陽曆日及余，其餘，先以一百乘之，樞法除為約分。

translations.literal: To find the new- or full-moon hour moon entry yin-yang calendar accumulated degrees: set its moon entry yin-yang calendar day and remainder; for the remainder, first multiply by 100, divide by the pivot factor for contracted parts.
translations.idiomatic: To find the syzygy hour accumulated degrees in the yin-yang calendars: set the moon's day and remainder in the yin or yang calendar; multiply the remainder by 100 and divide by the pivot factor to obtain contracted parts.

sentences.zh: 以九百九乘之，六十八除為度，不盡，退除為分，即朔、望加時月入陰陽曆積度及分。

translations.literal: Multiply by 999; divide by 68 for degrees; what does not exhaust, retreat-divide for parts — that is the new- or full-moon hour moon entry yin-yang calendar accumulated degrees and parts.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply by 999, divide by 68 for degrees, and treat the remainder as parts — thereby obtaining the syzygy hour accumulated degrees and parts in the yin-yang calendars.

sentences.zh: 其月在陽曆，即為入陽曆積度；

translations.literal: If the moon is in the yang calendar, that is entry yang-calendar accumulated degrees;
translations.idiomatic: If the moon is in the yang calendar, this is the accumulated degrees in the yang calendar;

sentences.zh: 月在陰曆，即為入陰曆積度。

translations.literal: if the moon is in the yin calendar, that is entry yin-calendar accumulated degrees.
translations.idiomatic: if the moon is in the yin calendar, this is the accumulated degrees in the yin calendar.

sentences.zh: 求朔望加時月去黃道度：置入陰陽曆積度及分，如交象以下為在少象；

translations.literal: To find the new- or full-moon hour moon's departure from the Yellow Path in degrees: set the yin-yang calendar accumulated degrees and parts; if at or below the convergence image, it is in the lesser image;
translations.idiomatic: To find the syzygy hour lunar latitude from the ecliptic: set the yin-yang accumulated degrees and parts; if at or below the convergence image, the moon is in the lesser image;

sentences.zh: 已上，覆減半交，餘為入老象。

translations.literal: if above, overlay-subtract half convergence — the remainder is entry into the greater image.
translations.idiomatic: if above, subtract from half convergence — the remainder marks entry into the greater image.

sentences.zh: 置所入老少象度及分，以五因之，用減一千一十，餘，以老少象度及分乘之，八十四而一，列於上位；

translations.literal: Set the lesser or greater image degrees and parts entered; multiply by 5; use to subtract from 1,010; with the remainder multiply by the lesser or greater image degrees and parts; divide by 84 — array in the upper position;
translations.idiomatic: Set the entered lesser or greater image degrees and parts, multiply by 5, subtract from 1,010, multiply the remainder by those degrees and parts, divide by 84, and place the result in the upper position;

sentences.zh: 又置所入老少象度及分，如半象以下為在初限；

translations.literal: again set the lesser or greater image degrees and parts entered; if at or below half image, it is in the initial limit;
translations.idiomatic: again set the entered lesser or greater image degrees and parts; if at or below half the image, the moon is in the initial limit;

sentences.zh: 已上，減去半象，餘為入末限。

translations.literal: if above, subtract half image — the remainder is entry into the final limit.
translations.idiomatic: if above, subtract half the image — the remainder marks entry into the final limit.

sentences.zh: 置初、末限底及分於上，列半象度及分於下，以上減下，餘以乘上，四十而一，所得，初限以減，末限以加，上位滿百為度，不滿為分，即朔、望加時月去黃道度數及分。

translations.literal: Set the initial and final limit bases and parts above, array half-image degrees and parts below; subtract below from above; multiply the remainder by above; divide by 40; what is obtained, for the initial limit subtract and for the final limit add; when the upper position fills 100 it becomes degrees, what does not fill becomes parts — that is the new- or full-moon hour moon's departure from the Yellow Path in degrees and parts.
translations.idiomatic: Place the initial and final limit bases and parts above and half-image degrees and parts below, subtract the lower from the upper, multiply the remainder by the upper value and divide by 40; subtract for the initial limit and add for the final limit; when the upper total reaches 100 count it as degrees and otherwise as parts — thereby obtaining the syzygy hour lunar latitude in degrees and parts.

sentences.zh: 求食定餘：置定朔小餘，如半法以下覆加半法，餘為午前分；

translations.literal: To find the eclipse fixed remainder: set the fixed new-moon minor remainder; if at or below half the divisor, overlay-add half the divisor — the remainder is the before-noon parts;
translations.idiomatic: To find the eclipse fixed remainder: set the fixed new-moon minor remainder; if at or below half the divisor, add half the divisor in overlay fashion — the result is the before-noon fraction;

sentences.zh: 已上，減去半法，餘為午後分。

translations.literal: if above, subtract half the divisor — the remainder is the after-noon parts.
translations.idiomatic: if above, subtract half the divisor — the remainder is the after-noon fraction.

sentences.zh: 置午前、後分於上，列半法於下，以上減下，以下乘上，午前以三萬一千七百七十除，午後以一萬三千八百八十五除之，各為時差。

translations.literal: Set the before- and after-noon parts above, array half the divisor below; subtract below from above; multiply below by above; before noon divide by 31,770, after noon divide by 13,885 — each is the time difference.
translations.idiomatic: Place before- and after-noon fractions above and half the divisor below, subtract the lower from the upper and multiply, divide before-noon results by 31,770 and after-noon results by 13,885 — each quotient is the time difference.

sentences.zh: 午前以減、午後以加定朔小餘，各為食定小餘。

translations.literal: Before noon subtract and after noon add to the fixed new-moon minor remainder — each is the eclipse fixed minor remainder.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract before noon and add after noon to the fixed new-moon minor remainder — each yields the eclipse fixed minor remainder.

sentences.zh: 以時差加午前、後分，為午前、後定分。

translations.literal: Add the time difference to the before- and after-noon parts — these are the before- and after-noon fixed parts.
translations.idiomatic: Add the time difference to the before- and after-noon fractions to obtain the fixed before- and after-noon parts.

sentences.zh: 其月食，直以定望小餘便為食定小餘。

translations.literal: For lunar eclipses, directly take the fixed full-moon minor remainder as the eclipse fixed minor remainder.
translations.idiomatic: For lunar eclipses, the fixed full-moon minor remainder itself serves as the eclipse fixed minor remainder.

sentences.zh: 求日月食甚辰刻：置食定小餘，以辰法除之為辰數，不滿，進一位，刻法除之為刻，不滿為刻分。

translations.literal: To find the solar or lunar eclipse greatest moment in double-hours and quarters: set the eclipse fixed minor remainder; divide by the double-hour divisor for double-hour count; what does not fill, advance one place; divide by the quarter divisor for quarters; what does not fill is quarter parts.
translations.idiomatic: To find the greatest eclipse moment in double-hours and quarters: set the eclipse fixed minor remainder, divide by the double-hour divisor for the double-hour count, advance one place for the remainder, divide by the quarter divisor for quarters, and treat any remainder as quarter parts.

sentences.zh: 其辰數命子正，算外，即食甚辰、刻及分。

translations.literal: Count the double-hour number from midnight, outside the count — that is the eclipse greatest double-hour, quarter, and parts.
translations.idiomatic: Count the double-hours from midnight (zi zheng), with the count exclusive, to obtain the greatest eclipse double-hour, quarter, and parts.

sentences.zh: 求氣差：置其朔中積，滿二至限去之，餘在一象以下為在初；

translations.literal: To find the qi difference: set its new-moon mid qi accumulated value; remove what fills the solstice limit; the remainder at or below one image is in the initial phase;
translations.idiomatic: To find the qi difference: set the new-moon mid-qi accumulated value, discard full solstice limits, and if the remainder is at or below one image the eclipse is in the initial phase;

sentences.zh: 已上，覆減二至限，餘為在末。

translations.literal: if above, overlay-subtract the solstice limit — the remainder is in the final phase.
translations.idiomatic: if above, subtract the solstice limit in overlay fashion — the remainder is in the final phase.

sentences.zh: 皆自相乘，進二位，滿二百三十六除之，用減三千五百三十三，為氣差。

translations.literal: Each self-multiplies, advance two places, divide by what fills 236, use to subtract from 3,533 — that is the qi difference.
translations.idiomatic: Square each value, advance two decimal places, divide by 236, subtract from 3,533 — the result is the qi difference.

sentences.zh: 以乘距午定分，半晝分而一，所得以減氣差，為定數。

translations.literal: Multiply by the noon-distance fixed parts; halve the day-half parts and divide by one; what is obtained subtract from the qi difference — that is the fixed number.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply by the fixed noon-distance parts, halve the day-half parts and divide, subtract the result from the qi difference — this is the fixed correction.

sentences.zh: 春分後，交初以減，交中以加；

translations.literal: After the spring equinox, at convergence beginning subtract and at convergence middle add;
translations.idiomatic: After the spring equinox, subtract at convergence beginning and add at convergence middle;

sentences.zh: 秋分後，交初以加，交中以減。

translations.literal: after the autumn equinox, at convergence beginning add and at convergence middle subtract.
translations.idiomatic: after the autumn equinox, add at convergence beginning and subtract at convergence middle.

sentences.zh: 求刻差：置其朔中積，滿二至限去之，餘，列二至限於下，以上減下，餘以乘上，進二位，滿二百三十六除之，為刻差以乘距午定分，四因之，樞法而一，為定數。

translations.literal: To find the quarter difference: set its new-moon mid qi accumulated value; remove what fills the solstice limit; for the remainder, array the solstice limit below; subtract below from above; multiply the remainder by above; advance two places; divide by what fills 236 — that is the quarter difference; multiply by the noon-distance fixed parts; multiply by 4; divide by the pivot factor for one — that is the fixed number.
translations.idiomatic: To find the quarter difference: set the new-moon mid-qi accumulated value, discard full solstice limits, place the solstice limit below the remainder, subtract and multiply as above, advance two places and divide by 236 for the quarter difference, multiply by the fixed noon-distance parts, multiply by 4, and divide by the pivot factor — yielding the fixed correction.

sentences.zh: 冬至後食甚在午前，夏至後食甚在午後。

translations.literal: After the winter solstice the eclipse greatest moment is before noon; after the summer solstice the eclipse greatest moment is after noon.
translations.idiomatic: After the winter solstice the greatest eclipse falls before noon; after the summer solstice it falls after noon.

sentences.zh: 交初以加，交中以減。

translations.literal: At convergence beginning add; at convergence middle subtract.
translations.idiomatic: Add at convergence beginning; subtract at convergence middle.

sentences.zh: 冬至後食甚在午後，夏至後食甚在午前。

translations.literal: After the winter solstice the eclipse greatest moment is after noon; after the summer solstice the eclipse greatest moment is before noon.
translations.idiomatic: After the winter solstice the greatest eclipse falls after noon; after the summer solstice it falls before noon.

sentences.zh: 交初以加，交中以減。

translations.literal: At convergence beginning add; at convergence middle subtract.
translations.idiomatic: Add at convergence beginning; subtract at convergence middle.

sentences.zh: 求日入食限：置入交定日及餘秒，以氣、刻、時三差定數各加減之，如中日及餘秒以下為不食；

translations.literal: To find the day's entry into the eclipse limit: set the fixed convergence day and remainder seconds; with the qi, quarter, and time three-difference fixed numbers each add or subtract; if at or below the middle day and remainder seconds, there is no eclipse;
translations.idiomatic: To find solar entry into the eclipse limit: set the fixed convergence day and remainder seconds, apply the qi, quarter, and time fixed corrections, and if the result is at or below the middle day and remainder seconds there is no eclipse;

sentences.zh: 已上者，減去中日及餘秒，如後限以下、前限已上為入食限；

translations.literal: if above, subtract the middle day and remainder seconds; if at or below the posterior limit and at or above the anterior limit, it is entry into the eclipse limit;
translations.idiomatic: if above, subtract the middle day and remainder seconds; if the result is at or below the posterior limit and at or above the anterior limit, the sun has entered the eclipse limit;

sentences.zh: 後限以下為交後分；

translations.literal: at or below the posterior limit is post-convergence parts;
translations.idiomatic: at or below the posterior limit counts as post-convergence parts;

sentences.zh: 前限以上覆減中日，餘為交前分。

translations.literal: at or above the anterior limit overlay-subtract the middle day — the remainder is pre-convergence parts.
translations.idiomatic: at or above the anterior limit, subtract the middle day in overlay fashion — the remainder is pre-convergence parts.

sentences.zh: 求日食分：置入交前後分，如陽曆食限以下者為陽曆食定分；

translations.literal: To find the solar eclipse parts: set the pre- and post-convergence parts; if at or below the yang-calendar eclipse limit, that is the yang-calendar eclipse fixed parts;
translations.idiomatic: To find the solar eclipse magnitude: set the pre- and post-convergence parts; if at or below the yang-calendar eclipse limit, that value is the yang-calendar fixed eclipse parts;

sentences.zh: 已上者，覆減一萬一千二百，餘為陰曆食定分；

translations.literal: if above, overlay-subtract 11,200 — the remainder is the yin-calendar eclipse fixed parts;
translations.idiomatic: if above, subtract 11,200 in overlay fashion — the remainder is the yin-calendar fixed eclipse parts;

sentences.zh: 不足減者，不食。

translations.literal: if insufficient to subtract, there is no eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: if the subtraction cannot be completed, there is no eclipse.

sentences.zh: 各如限陽曆定法而一，為食之大分，不盡，退除為小分，半已上為半強，半以下為半弱。

translations.literal: Each as the limit yang-calendar fixed divisor for one — that is the eclipse major parts; what does not exhaust, retreat-divide for minor parts; half and above is half-strong, half and below is half-weak.
translations.idiomatic: Divide each by the appropriate yang- or yin-calendar fixed divisor to obtain major eclipse parts; treat the remainder as minor parts, calling half and above half-strong and half and below half-weak.

sentences.zh: 命大分以十為限，得日食之分。

translations.literal: Count the major parts with ten as the limit — obtain the solar eclipse parts.
translations.idiomatic: Take ten as the limit for the major parts to obtain the solar eclipse magnitude.

sentences.zh: 求日食泛用分：置朔入陰陽曆食定分，一百約之，在陽曆者列入十四於下，在陰曆者列一百四十於下，各以上減下，餘以乘上，進二位，陽曆以一百八十五除，陰曆以五百一十四除，各為日食泛用分。

translations.literal: To find the solar eclipse general-use parts: set the new-moon entry yin-yang calendar eclipse fixed parts; contract by 100; if in the yang calendar array 14 below, if in the yin calendar array 140 below; each subtract below from above; multiply the remainder by above; advance two places; yang calendar divide by 185, yin calendar divide by 514 — each is the solar eclipse general-use parts.
translations.idiomatic: To find the solar eclipse general-use parts: set the new-moon fixed eclipse parts in the yin-yang calendars and contract by 100; for the yang calendar place 14 below, for the yin calendar place 140 below; subtract, multiply, advance two places, divide by 185 for yang and 514 for yin — each quotient is the solar eclipse general-use parts.

sentences.zh: 求月入食限：視月入陰陽曆日及餘，如後限以下為交後分；

translations.literal: To find the moon's entry into the eclipse limit: observe the moon's yin-yang calendar day and remainder; if at or below the posterior limit, that is post-convergence parts;
translations.idiomatic: To find lunar entry into the eclipse limit: inspect the moon's day and remainder in the yin-yang calendars; if at or below the posterior limit, that is post-convergence parts;

sentences.zh: 前限已上覆減中日，為交前分。

translations.literal: at or above the anterior limit overlay-subtract the middle day — that is pre-convergence parts.
translations.idiomatic: at or above the anterior limit, subtract the middle day in overlay fashion — that is pre-convergence parts.

sentences.zh: 求月食分：置交前後分，如三千二百以下者，食既；

translations.literal: To find the lunar eclipse parts: set the pre- and post-convergence parts; if at or below 3,200, the eclipse is total;
translations.idiomatic: To find the lunar eclipse magnitude: set the pre- and post-convergence parts; if at or below 3,200, the eclipse is total;

sentences.zh: 已上，用減一萬二百，不足減者不食；

translations.literal: if above, use to subtract 10,200; if insufficient to subtract, there is no eclipse;
translations.idiomatic: if above, subtract 10,200; if the subtraction cannot be completed, there is no eclipse;

sentences.zh: 餘以七百除之為大分，不盡，退除為小分，小分半已上為半強，半已下為半弱。

translations.literal: the remainder divide by 700 for major parts; what does not exhaust, retreat-divide for minor parts; minor parts half and above are half-strong, half and below are half-weak.
translations.idiomatic: divide the remainder by 700 for major parts and treat the remainder as minor parts, calling half and above half-strong and half and below half-weak.

sentences.zh: 命大分以十為限，得月食之分。

translations.literal: Count the major parts with ten as the limit — obtain the lunar eclipse parts.
translations.idiomatic: Take ten as the limit for the major parts to obtain the lunar eclipse magnitude.

sentences.zh: 求月食泛用分：置望入交前後分，退一等，自相乘，交初以九百三十五除，交中以一千一百五十六除之，得數用減刻率，交初以一千一百一十一為刻率，交中以九百為刻率。

translations.literal: To find the lunar eclipse general-use parts: set the full-moon entry pre- and post-convergence parts; retreat one grade; self-multiply; at convergence beginning divide by 935, at convergence middle divide by 1,156; the number obtained use to subtract from the quarter rate — at convergence beginning 1,111 is the quarter rate, at convergence middle 900 is the quarter rate.
translations.idiomatic: To find the lunar eclipse general-use parts: set the full-moon pre- and post-convergence parts, reduce one grade and square them; at convergence beginning divide by 935 and at convergence middle by 1,156; subtract the result from the quarter rate — 1,111 at convergence beginning and 900 at convergence middle.

sentences.zh: 各得所求。

translations.literal: Each obtains what is sought.
translations.idiomatic: Each procedure yields the desired result.

sentences.zh: 求日月食定用分：置日月食泛用分，以一千三百三十七乘之，以所食日轉定分除之，即得所求。

translations.literal: To find the solar or lunar eclipse fixed-use parts: set the solar or lunar eclipse general-use parts; multiply by 1,337; divide by that day's rotation fixed parts — thereby obtaining what is sought.
translations.idiomatic: To find the fixed-use parts for a solar or lunar eclipse: set the general-use parts, multiply by 1,337, divide by that day's rotation fixed parts — thereby obtaining the desired value.

sentences.zh: 求日月食虧初復滿小餘：各以定用分減食甚小餘，為虧初；

translations.literal: To find the solar or lunar eclipse first contact and full restoration minor remainders: each subtract the fixed-use parts from the eclipse greatest minor remainder — that is first contact;
translations.idiomatic: To find the minor remainders for first contact and full restoration: subtract the fixed-use parts from the greatest-eclipse minor remainder for first contact;

sentences.zh: 加食甚小餘，為復滿：即各得虧初復滿小餘。

translations.literal: add the eclipse greatest minor remainder — that is full restoration: thereby each obtains the first-contact and full-restoration minor remainders.
translations.idiomatic: add the fixed-use parts to the greatest-eclipse minor remainder for full restoration — thereby obtaining both minor remainders.

sentences.zh: 若求時刻者，依食甚術入之。

translations.literal: If seeking the time and quarter, follow the eclipse-greatest procedure to enter it.
translations.idiomatic: To convert to clock time, apply the greatest-eclipse procedure.

sentences.zh: 求月食更籌定法：置其望晨分，四因之，退一等，為更法；

translations.literal: To find the lunar eclipse watch and tally fixed divisors: set its full-moon dawn parts; multiply by 4; retreat one grade — that is the watch divisor;
translations.idiomatic: To find the lunar eclipse watch and tally fixed divisors: set the full-moon dawn parts, multiply by 4 and reduce one grade — that is the watch divisor;

sentences.zh: 倍之，退一等，為籌法。

translations.literal: double it; retreat one grade — that is the tally divisor.
translations.idiomatic: double it and reduce one grade — that is the tally divisor.

sentences.zh: 求月食入更籌：置虧初、食甚、復滿小餘，在晨分以下加晨分，昏分已上減去昏分，餘以更法除之為更數，不滿，以籌法除之為籌數。

translations.literal: To find the lunar eclipse entry into watches and tallies: set the first-contact, greatest, and full-restoration minor remainders; if at or below dawn parts add dawn parts; if at or above dusk parts subtract dusk parts; the remainder divide by the watch divisor for watch count; what does not fill, divide by the tally divisor for tally count.
translations.idiomatic: To find the lunar eclipse watch and tally entry: set the first-contact, greatest, and full-restoration minor remainders; add dawn parts if below dawn and subtract dusk parts if above dusk; divide the remainder by the watch divisor for watches and by the tally divisor for tallies.

sentences.zh: 其更數命初更，算外，即各得所入更、籌。

translations.literal: Count the watch number from the first watch, outside the count — thereby each obtains the watch and tally entered.
translations.idiomatic: Count the watches from the first watch (exclusive) to obtain the watch and tally for each phase.

sentences.zh: 求朔、望食甚宿次：置其經朔、望入氣小餘，以入氣、入轉朏朒定數朏減朒加之，乘其日升降分，樞法而一，加減其日盈縮分，至後、分前以加，分後、至前以減。

translations.literal: To find the new- or full-moon eclipse greatest lodge position: set its mean new- or full-moon qi-entry minor remainder; with qi-entry and rotation-entry waxing-waning fixed numbers subtract for waning and add for waxing; multiply its day's ascent-descent parts; divide by the pivot factor for one; add or subtract its day's excess-deficit parts — after a solstice and before an equinox add, after an equinox and before a solstice subtract.
translations.idiomatic: To find the lodge of greatest eclipse at new or full moon: set the mean syzygy qi-entry minor remainder, apply qi-entry and rotation waxing-waning corrections, multiply the day's ascent-descent parts and divide by the pivot factor, then add or subtract the day's excess-deficit parts — adding after solstice and before equinox, subtracting after equinox and before solstice.

sentences.zh: 一百約之為分，分滿百為度，以盈加縮減其定朔、望加時中積，以天正冬至加時黃道日度及分加而命之，即定朔、望加時日躔宿次。

translations.literal: Contract by 100 for parts; when parts fill 100 they become degrees; with excess add and deficit subtract to its fixed new- or full-moon hour mid accumulated value; add and count from the civil winter-solstice hour Yellow Path solar degrees and parts — that is the fixed new- or full-moon hour solar progression lodge position.
translations.idiomatic: Contract by 100 for parts and promote every 100 parts to a degree; add excess and subtract deficit from the fixed syzygy hour mid-accumulation, then add the civil winter-solstice hour ecliptic solar longitude and count the lodges — thereby obtaining the fixed syzygy hour solar position.

sentences.zh: 其望加半周天，命如前，即朔、望食甚宿次。

translations.literal: For the full moon add half a circuit of heaven; count as before — that is the new- or full-moon eclipse greatest lodge position.
translations.idiomatic: For full moon add half a celestial circuit and count as before — thereby obtaining the lodge of greatest eclipse.

sentences.zh: 求月食既內外刻分：置月食交前、後分，覆減三千二百，不及減者，為食下既。

translations.literal: To find the lunar eclipse totality inner and outer quarter parts: set the lunar eclipse pre- and post-convergence parts; overlay-subtract 3,200; if insufficient to subtract, that is totality below the eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: To find the inner and outer quarter parts of lunar totality: set the pre- and post-convergence parts and subtract 3,200 in overlay fashion; if the subtraction cannot be completed, the eclipse is total throughout.

sentences.zh: 一百約之，列六十四於下，以上減下，餘以乘上，進二位，交初以二百九十三除，交中以三百六十五除，所得，以定用分乘之，如泛用分而一，為月食既內刻分；

translations.literal: Contract by 100; array 64 below; subtract below from above; multiply the remainder by above; advance two places; at convergence beginning divide by 293, at convergence middle divide by 365; what is obtained, multiply by the fixed-use parts; as the general-use parts for one — that is the lunar eclipse totality inner quarter parts;
translations.idiomatic: Contract by 100, place 64 below, subtract and multiply as above, advance two places and divide by 293 at convergence beginning or 365 at convergence middle; multiply by the fixed-use parts and divide by the general-use parts — yielding the inner quarter parts of lunar totality;

sentences.zh: 覆減定用分，即既外刻分。

translations.literal: overlay-subtract the fixed-use parts — that is the totality outer quarter parts.
translations.idiomatic: subtract the fixed-use parts in overlay fashion — that is the outer quarter parts of totality.

sentences.zh: 求日月帶食出入分數：各以食定小餘與日出、入分相減，餘為帶食差；

translations.literal: To find the solar or lunar grazing-eclipse rising-setting parts: each subtract the eclipse fixed minor remainder from the sunrise and sunset parts — the remainder is the grazing-eclipse difference;
translations.idiomatic: To find the grazing-eclipse rising and setting fractions: subtract the eclipse fixed minor remainder from the sunrise or sunset parts — the remainder is the grazing-eclipse difference;

sentences.zh: 其帶食差滿定用分已上者，不帶食出入也。

translations.literal: if the grazing-eclipse difference fills the fixed-use parts or above, there is no grazing eclipse at rising or setting.
translations.idiomatic: if the grazing-eclipse difference equals or exceeds the fixed-use parts, there is no grazing eclipse at rising or setting.

sentences.zh: 以帶食差乘所食分，滿定用分而一，若月食既者，以既內刻分減帶食差，餘所食分，以既外刻分而一，不及減者，為帶食既出入也。

translations.literal: Multiply the grazing-eclipse difference by the eclipsed parts; fill the fixed-use parts for one; if a lunar eclipse is total, subtract the totality inner quarter parts from the grazing-eclipse difference — the remainder is the eclipsed parts; as the totality outer quarter parts for one; if insufficient to subtract, that is grazing totality at rising or setting.
translations.idiomatic: Multiply the grazing-eclipse difference by the eclipse magnitude and divide by the fixed-use parts; for a total lunar eclipse subtract the inner totality quarter parts from the difference and divide the remainder by the outer totality quarter parts — if the subtraction cannot be completed, the grazing eclipse is total at rising or setting.

sentences.zh: 各以減所食分，即帶出、入所見之分。

translations.literal: Each subtract from the eclipsed parts — that is the grazing rising or setting visible parts.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract each result from the eclipse magnitude to obtain the visible grazing fraction at rising or setting.

sentences.zh: 其朔日食甚在晝者，晨為漸進之分，昏為已退之分；

translations.literal: If the new-moon solar eclipse greatest moment is in daytime, dawn is the gradually advancing parts and dusk is the already receding parts;
translations.idiomatic: When the new-moon solar eclipse greatest moment falls in daylight, dawn marks the gradually advancing fraction and dusk the already receding fraction;

sentences.zh: 若食甚在夜者，晨為已退之分，昏為漸進之分。

translations.literal: if the eclipse greatest moment is at night, dawn is the already receding parts and dusk is the gradually advancing parts.
translations.idiomatic: if the greatest moment falls at night, dawn marks the already receding fraction and dusk the gradually advancing fraction.

sentences.zh: 其月食者，見此可知也。

translations.literal: For lunar eclipses, seeing this one may know.
translations.idiomatic: The same reasoning applies to lunar eclipses.

sentences.zh: 求日食所起：日在陰曆，初起西北，甚於正北，復于東北；

translations.literal: To find where the solar eclipse begins: when the sun is in the yin calendar, it first begins in the northwest, is greatest due north, and restores in the northeast;
translations.idiomatic: To find the solar eclipse's starting direction: when the sun is in the yin calendar, contact begins in the northwest, reaches maximum due north, and ends in the northeast;

sentences.zh: 日在陽曆，初起西南，甚于正南，復于東南。

translations.literal: when the sun is in the yang calendar, it first begins in the southwest, is greatest due south, and restores in the southeast.
translations.idiomatic: when the sun is in the yang calendar, contact begins in the southwest, reaches maximum due south, and ends in the southeast.

sentences.zh: 其食八分已上者，皆起正西，復於正東。

translations.literal: If the eclipse is eight-tenths or above, all first rise due west and restore due east.
translations.idiomatic: When the eclipse magnitude is eight-tenths or greater, contact always begins due west and ends due east.

sentences.zh: 此據午地而論之，其餘方位，審黃道斜正、月行所向，可知方向。

translations.literal: This is discussed with reference to the noon meridian; for other directions, examine the Yellow Path's obliquity and the moon's motion direction — the direction may be known.
translations.idiomatic: This assumes the noon meridian as reference; for other locations, inspect the ecliptic's obliquity and the moon's direction of motion to determine the bearing.

sentences.zh: 求月食所起：月在陰曆，初起東南，甚于正南，復於西南；

translations.literal: To find where the lunar eclipse begins: when the moon is in the yin calendar, it first begins in the southeast, is greatest due south, and restores in the southwest;
translations.idiomatic: To find the lunar eclipse's starting direction: when the moon is in the yin calendar, contact begins in the southeast, reaches maximum due south, and ends in the southwest;

sentences.zh: 月在陽曆，初起東北，甚於正北，復於西北。

translations.literal: when the moon is in the yang calendar, it first begins in the northeast, is greatest due north, and restores in the northwest.
translations.idiomatic: when the moon is in the yang calendar, contact begins in the northeast, reaches maximum due north, and ends in the northwest.

sentences.zh: 其食八分已上，皆起正東，復於正西。

translations.literal: If the eclipse is eight-tenths or above, all first rise due east and restore due west.
translations.idiomatic: When the eclipse magnitude is eight-tenths or greater, contact always begins due east and ends due west.

sentences.zh: 此亦據午地而論之，其餘方位，依日食所向，即知既虧、復滿。

translations.literal: This also is discussed with reference to the noon meridian; for other directions, follow the solar eclipse's direction — thereby knowing totality, first contact, and full restoration.
translations.idiomatic: This likewise assumes the noon meridian; for other locations, follow the solar eclipse's directional rule to determine totality, first contact, and full restoration.

sentences.zh: 推五星天正冬至後諸變中積中星：置氣積分，各以其星周率去之，不盡，覆減周率，余滿樞法除之為日，不滿，退除為分，即天正冬至後平合中積；

translations.literal: To find the five planets' civil winter-solstice posterior various-phase mid-accumulations and mid-stars: set the qi accumulated parts; each remove by that planet's circuit rate; what does not exhaust, overlay-subtract the circuit rate; the remainder, when it fills the pivot factor divide for days, what does not fill retreat-divide for parts — that is the civil winter-solstice posterior mean-conjunction mid-accumulation;
translations.idiomatic: To find each planet's mid-accumulation and mid-star for all phases after the civil winter solstice: set the qi accumulated parts, discard full circuit rates for each planet, overlay-subtract the circuit rate from the remainder, divide by the pivot factor for days and parts — thereby obtaining the mean-conjunction mid-accumulation after the civil winter solstice;

sentences.zh: 命之，積平合中星，以諸段變日、變度累加之，即諸變中積中星。

translations.literal: count it, accumulate mean-conjunction mid-stars, with each segment's phase-change days and phase-change degrees accumulate and add — that is each phase's mid-accumulation and mid-star.
translations.idiomatic: count the lodges, accumulate the mean-conjunction mid-stars, and add each segment's phase-change days and degrees cumulatively — thereby obtaining the mid-accumulation and mid-star for every phase.

sentences.zh: 其經退行者，即其變度；

translations.literal: for those that regularly retrograde, that is their phase-change degrees;
translations.idiomatic: For segments that regularly retrograde, use the phase-change degrees;

sentences.zh: 累減之，即其星其變中星。

translations.literal: accumulate and subtract — that is that planet's phase mid-star.
translations.idiomatic: accumulate by subtraction — thereby obtaining that planet's phase mid-star.

sentences.zh: 求五星諸變入曆：以其星歲差乘積年，滿周天分去之，不盡，以樞法除之為度，不滿，退除為分，以減其星平合中星，即平合入曆；

translations.literal: To find the five planets' various phases' calendar entry: multiply that planet's annual difference by accumulated years; remove what fills the circuit-of-heaven parts; what does not exhaust, divide by the pivot factor for degrees, what does not fill retreat-divide for parts; subtract from that planet's mean-conjunction mid-star — that is mean-conjunction calendar entry;
translations.idiomatic: To find calendar entry for each planetary phase: multiply that planet's annual difference by accumulated years, discard full circuit-of-heaven parts, divide the remainder by the pivot factor for degrees and parts, and subtract from the mean-conjunction mid-star — thereby obtaining mean-conjunction calendar entry;

sentences.zh: 以其星其變限度依次加之，各得其星諸變入曆度分。

translations.literal: with that planet's phase-change limit degrees add in sequence — each obtains that planet's various phases' calendar-entry degrees and parts.
translations.idiomatic: add each planet's phase-change limit degrees in sequence to obtain the calendar-entry degrees and parts for every phase.

sentences.zh: 求五星諸變盈縮定差：各置其星其變入曆度分，半周天以下為在盈；

translations.literal: To find the five planets' various phases' excess-deficit fixed differences: each set that planet's phase calendar-entry degrees and parts; at or below half a circuit of heaven is in excess;
translations.idiomatic: To find the fixed excess-deficit correction for each planetary phase: set that phase's calendar-entry degrees and parts; if at or below half a celestial circuit the planet is in the excess zone;

sentences.zh: 以上，減去半周天，餘為在縮。

translations.literal: if above, subtract half a circuit of heaven — the remainder is in deficit.
translations.idiomatic: if above, subtract half a celestial circuit — the remainder is in the deficit zone.

sentences.zh: 置盈縮限度及分，以五星會策除之為會數，不盡，為入會度及分；

translations.literal: set the excess-deficit limit degrees and parts; divide by the five-planet conjunction stride for conjunction number; what does not exhaust is entry-conjunction degrees and parts;
translations.idiomatic: Set the excess-deficit limit degrees and parts, divide by the five-planet conjunction stride for the conjunction number, and treat the remainder as entry-conjunction degrees and parts;

sentences.zh: 以其會下損益率乘之，會策除之為分，分滿百為度，以損益其下盈縮積度，即其星其變盈縮定差。

translations.literal: multiply by the damage-benefit rate below that conjunction; divide by the conjunction stride for parts; when parts fill 100 they become degrees; damage or benefit the excess-deficit accumulated degrees below — that is that planet's phase excess-deficit fixed difference.
translations.idiomatic: multiply by the damage-benefit rate for that conjunction, divide by the conjunction stride for parts and promote every 100 parts to a degree, then apply to the accumulated excess-deficit degrees below — thereby obtaining that planet's fixed excess-deficit correction for the phase.

sentences.zh: 若用立成者，以其所入會度下差而用之。

translations.literal: If using ready-made tables, use the difference below the conjunction degrees entered.
translations.idiomatic: When using ready-made tables, apply the difference listed below the entered conjunction degrees.

sentences.zh: 其木火土三星後退、後留者，置盈縮差，各列其星盈縮極度於下，皆以上減下，餘以乘上，八十七除之，所得，木、土三因，火直用之；

translations.literal: For Jupiter, Mars, and Saturn in posterior retrograde and posterior station: set the excess-deficit difference; each array that planet's excess-deficit extreme degrees below; all subtract below from above; multiply the remainder by above; divide by 87; what is obtained, for Jupiter and Saturn multiply by 3, for Mars use directly;
translations.idiomatic: For Jupiter, Mars, and Saturn in posterior retrograde or posterior station: set the excess-deficit difference, place each planet's extreme excess-deficit degrees below, subtract and multiply as above, divide by 87, triple the result for Jupiter and Saturn and use it directly for Mars;

sentences.zh: 在盈益減損加、在縮益加損減其段盈縮差，為後退、後留定差，因為後遲初段定差。

translations.literal: in excess benefit-subtract damage-add, in deficit benefit-add damage-subtract to that segment's excess-deficit difference — that is the posterior retrograde and posterior station fixed difference, thereby becoming the posterior slow initial segment fixed difference.
translations.idiomatic: in the excess zone subtract when benefiting and add when damaging, in the deficit zone add when benefiting and subtract when damaging — apply to the segment's excess-deficit difference for posterior retrograde and station fixed corrections, which also serve as the posterior slow initial segment fixed correction.

sentences.zh: 各須類會前留定差，觀其盈縮初末，審察降殺，皆裒多益少而用之。

translations.literal: Each must classify and match the anterior station fixed difference; observe its excess-deficit beginning and end; examine decrease and reduction; all use 'wrap more and benefit less.'
translations.idiomatic: Each must be classified with the anterior station fixed correction; observe whether excess or deficit applies at the beginning or end, examine the rate of decrease, and apply the principle of wrapping more and benefiting less throughout.

sentences.zh: 求五星諸變定積：各置其星其變中積，以其變盈縮定差盈加縮減之，即其星其變定積及分；

translations.literal: To find the five planets' various phases' fixed accumulations: each set that planet's phase mid-accumulation; with that phase's excess-deficit fixed difference excess-add deficit-subtract — that is that planet's phase fixed accumulation and parts;
translations.idiomatic: To find the fixed accumulation for each planetary phase: set that phase's mid-accumulation, add the fixed excess-deficit correction when in excess and subtract when in deficit — thereby obtaining the fixed accumulation and parts;

sentences.zh: 以天正冬至大餘及分加之，即其星其變定日及分；

translations.literal: add the civil winter-solstice major remainder and parts — that is that planet's phase fixed day and parts;
translations.idiomatic: add the civil winter-solstice major remainder and parts to obtain the fixed day and parts for that phase;

sentences.zh: 以紀法去定日，不盡，命甲子，算外，即得日辰。

translations.literal: remove the era divisor from the fixed day; what does not exhaust, count from jiazi, outside the count — thereby obtaining the day and double-hour.
translations.idiomatic: discard full era divisors from the fixed day, count from jiazi exclusive, and obtain the day and double-hour.

sentences.zh: 求五星諸變在何月日：各置諸變定日，以其年天正經朔大餘及分減之，若冬至大餘少，加經朔大餘者，加紀法乃減之。

translations.literal: To find which month and day the five planets' various phases fall in: each set the various phases' fixed days; subtract that year's civil mean new-moon major remainder and parts; if the winter-solstice major remainder is less, for those who add the mean new-moon major remainder, add the era divisor then subtract.
translations.idiomatic: To find the month and day of each planetary phase: set each phase's fixed day and subtract that year's civil mean new-moon major remainder and parts; if the winter-solstice major remainder is smaller, add the era divisor before subtracting the mean new-moon major remainder.

sentences.zh: 餘以朔策及分除之為月數，不滿，為入月日數及分。

translations.literal: the remainder divide by the new-moon stride and parts for month count; what does not fill is entry-month day count and parts.
translations.idiomatic: Divide the remainder by the new-moon stride and parts for the month count, and treat the remainder as days and parts within the month.

sentences.zh: 其月數命以天正十一月，算外，即其星其變入其月經朔日數及分。

translations.literal: Count the month number from the civil eleventh month, outside the count — that is that planet's phase entry into that month's mean new-moon day count and parts.
translations.idiomatic: Count the months from the civil eleventh month exclusive to obtain that planet's phase day and parts from the month's mean new moon.

sentences.zh: 若置定積，以天正閏月及分加之，朔策除為月數，亦得所求。

translations.literal: If setting the fixed accumulation, add the civil intercalary month and parts; divide by the new-moon stride for month count — one also obtains what is sought.
translations.idiomatic: Alternatively, set the fixed accumulation, add the civil intercalary month and parts, and divide by the new-moon stride for the month count — the same result follows.

sentences.zh: 求五星諸變入何氣日：置定積，以氣策及約分除之為氣數，不盡，為入氣已來日數及分。

translations.literal: To find which qi day the five planets' various phases enter: set the fixed accumulation; divide by the qi stride and contracted parts for qi count; what does not exhaust is days and parts since qi entry.
translations.idiomatic: To find which qi day each phase enters: set the fixed accumulation, divide by the qi stride and contracted parts for the qi count, and treat the remainder as days and parts elapsed within the qi.

sentences.zh: 其氣數命起天正冬至，算外，即五星諸變入其氣日及分。

translations.literal: Count the qi number from the civil winter solstice, outside the count — that is the five planets' various phases' entry qi day and parts.
translations.idiomatic: Count the qi from the civil winter solstice exclusive to obtain the qi day and parts for each planetary phase.

sentences.zh: 其定積滿歲周日及分即去之，餘在來年天正冬至後。

translations.literal: If the fixed accumulation fills the annual circuit day and parts, remove it — the remainder is after the next year's civil winter solstice.
translations.idiomatic: When the fixed accumulation fills an annual circuit day and parts, discard it — the remainder falls after the following year's civil winter solstice.

sentences.zh: 求五星諸變定星：各置其變中星，以其變盈縮定差盈加縮減之，其金、水二星，金以倍之，水以三之，乃可加減。

translations.literal: To find the five planets' various phases' fixed stars: each set its phase mid-star; with its phase excess-deficit fixed difference excess-add deficit-subtract; for Venus and Mercury, Venus double it, Mercury triple it — only then may one add or subtract.
translations.idiomatic: To find the fixed star for each planetary phase: set the phase mid-star and apply the fixed excess-deficit correction, doubling it for Venus and tripling for Mercury before adding or subtracting.

sentences.zh: 即五星諸變定星；

translations.literal: thereby the five planets' various phases' fixed stars;
translations.idiomatic: Thereby obtaining the fixed star for each planetary phase;

sentences.zh: 以天正冬至加時黃道日度加而命之，即其星其變加時定星宿次及分。

translations.literal: add and count from the civil winter-solstice hour Yellow Path solar degrees — that is that planet's phase hour fixed star lodge position and parts.
translations.idiomatic: add the civil winter-solstice hour ecliptic solar longitude and count the lodges — thereby obtaining the hour fixed star lodge and parts for that phase.

sentences.zh: 五星皆以前留為前退初日定星，後留為後遲初日定星。

translations.literal: All five planets take the anterior station as the anterior retrograde initial-day fixed star, and the posterior station as the posterior slow initial-day fixed star.
translations.idiomatic: For all five planets, the anterior station marks the fixed star for the first day of anterior retrograde, and the posterior station marks the fixed star for the first day of posterior slow motion.

sentences.zh: 求五星諸變初日晨前夜半定星：以其星其變盈縮所入會度下盈縮積度與次度下盈縮積度相減，餘為其度損益分；

translations.literal: To find the five planets' various phases' initial-day pre-dawn midnight fixed stars: with that planet's phase excess-deficit entry-conjunction degrees' excess-deficit accumulated degrees below subtract the next degree's excess-deficit accumulated degrees below — the remainder is its degree damage-benefit parts;
translations.idiomatic: To find the pre-dawn midnight fixed star for the first day of each phase: subtract the excess-deficit accumulated degrees at the next conjunction degree from those at the entered conjunction degree — the remainder is the degree damage-benefit fraction;

sentences.zh: 乘其變初行率，一百約之，所得，以加減其日初行率，在盈，益加損減；

translations.literal: multiply by its phase initial motion rate; contract by 100; what is obtained use to add or subtract its day's initial motion rate; in excess, benefit-add damage-subtract;
translations.idiomatic: multiply by the phase's initial motion rate and contract by 100, then apply to the day's initial motion rate — in the excess zone add when benefiting and subtract when damaging;

sentences.zh: 在縮，益減損加。

translations.literal: in deficit, benefit-subtract damage-add.
translations.idiomatic: in the deficit zone subtract when benefiting and add when damaging.

sentences.zh: 為初行積率；

translations.literal: that is the initial-motion accumulated rate;
translations.idiomatic: This yields the initial-motion accumulated rate;

sentences.zh: 又置一百分，亦依其數加減之，以除初行積率，為初日定行率；

translations.literal: again set 100 parts, likewise according to its number add or subtract; divide the initial-motion accumulated rate — that is the initial-day fixed motion rate;
translations.idiomatic: again set 100 parts and apply the same addition or subtraction, then divide the initial-motion accumulated rate to obtain the initial-day fixed motion rate;

sentences.zh: 以乘其率初日約分，一百約之，順減退加其日加時定星，為其變晨前夜半定星；

translations.literal: multiply by its rate's initial-day contracted parts; contract by 100; for direct motion subtract and for retrograde add to its day's hour fixed star — that is its phase pre-dawn midnight fixed star;
translations.idiomatic: multiply by the initial-day contracted parts of the rate and contract by 100, subtract for direct motion and add for retrograde to the hour fixed star — thereby obtaining the pre-dawn midnight fixed star for the phase;

sentences.zh: 加冬至時日度命之，即所在宿次。

translations.literal: add the winter-solstice hour solar degrees and count — that is the lodge position where it is.
translations.idiomatic: add the winter-solstice hour solar longitude and count the lodges to obtain the position.

sentences.zh: 求諸變日度率：置後變定日，以其變定日減之，餘為其變日率；

translations.literal: To find the various phases' day and degree rates: set the posterior phase's fixed day; subtract this phase's fixed day — the remainder is this phase's day rate;
translations.idiomatic: To find the day and degree rates for each phase: set the following phase's fixed day and subtract this phase's fixed day — the remainder is the day rate;

sentences.zh: 又置後變夜半定星，以其變夜半定星及分減之，餘為其變度率及分。

translations.literal: again set the posterior phase's midnight fixed star; subtract this phase's midnight fixed star and parts — the remainder is this phase's degree rate and parts.
translations.idiomatic: again set the following phase's midnight fixed star and subtract this phase's midnight fixed star and parts — the remainder is the degree rate and parts.

sentences.zh: 求諸變平行分：各置其變度率及分，以其變日率除之為平行分，不滿，退除為秒，即各得平行度及分秒。

translations.literal: To find the various phases' mean motion parts: each set its phase degree rate and parts; divide by its phase day rate for mean motion parts; what does not fill, retreat-divide for seconds — each thereby obtains mean motion degrees and parts seconds.
translations.idiomatic: To find the mean motion for each phase: set the degree rate and parts, divide by the day rate for mean motion parts, and treat the remainder as seconds — thereby obtaining mean motion in degrees, parts, and seconds.

sentences.zh: 求諸變總差：各以其段平行分與後段平行分相減，餘為泛差；

translations.literal: To find the various phases' total differences: each subtract this segment's mean motion parts from the next segment's mean motion parts — the remainder is the general difference;
translations.idiomatic: To find the total difference for each phase: subtract this segment's mean motion from the next segment's mean motion — the remainder is the general difference;

sentences.zh: 並前段泛差，四因之，九而一，為總差。

translations.literal: combine with the anterior segment's general difference; multiply by 4; divide by 9 for one — that is the total difference.
translations.idiomatic: combine with the previous segment's general difference, multiply by 4, and divide by 9 — yielding the total difference.

sentences.zh: 若前段無平行分相減為泛差者，各因後段初日行分與其段平行分相減，為半總差；

translations.literal: if the anterior segment has no mean motion parts to subtract for a general difference, each take the next segment's initial-day motion parts and subtract this segment's mean motion parts — that is half the total difference;
translations.idiomatic: If the previous segment lacks a mean motion subtraction for the general difference, subtract this segment's mean motion from the next segment's initial-day motion parts — yielding half the total difference;

sentences.zh: 倍之，為總差。

translations.literal: double it — that is the total difference.
translations.idiomatic: double it to obtain the total difference.

sentences.zh: 若後段無平行分相減為泛差者，各因前段末日行分與其段平行分相減，為半總差。

translations.literal: If the posterior segment has no mean motion parts to subtract for a general difference, each take the anterior segment's final-day motion parts and subtract this segment's mean motion parts — that is half the total difference.
translations.idiomatic: If the following segment lacks a mean motion subtraction for the general difference, subtract this segment's mean motion from the previous segment's final-day motion parts — yielding half the total difference.

sentences.zh: 其前後退行者，各置本段平行分，十四乘，十五除，為總差。

translations.literal: For those that retrograde before and after, each set this segment's mean motion parts; multiply by 14; divide by 15 — that is the total difference.
translations.idiomatic: For retrograde segments before and after, set this segment's mean motion parts, multiply by 14, and divide by 15 — yielding the total difference.

sentences.zh: 其金星夕退、夕伏、再合、晨退，各依順段術入之，即得所求。

translations.literal: For Venus evening retrograde, evening occultation, second conjunction, and morning retrograde, each follow the direct-segment procedure to enter — thereby obtaining what is sought.
translations.idiomatic: For Venus evening retrograde, evening occultation, second conjunction, and morning retrograde, apply the direct-segment procedure in each case to obtain the desired result.

sentences.zh: 求諸段初末日行分：各半其段總差，加減其段平行分，後段行分多者，減之為初，加之為末；

translations.literal: To find each segment's initial and final day motion parts: each halve that segment's total difference; add or subtract to that segment's mean motion parts; if the next segment's motion parts are greater, subtract for initial and add for final;
translations.idiomatic: To find initial and final daily motion for each segment: halve the segment's total difference and add or subtract from the mean motion — if the next segment's motion is greater, subtract for the initial day and add for the final;

sentences.zh: 後段行分少者，加之為初，減之為末。

translations.literal: if the next segment's motion parts are fewer, add for initial and subtract for final.
translations.idiomatic: if the next segment's motion is smaller, add for the initial day and subtract for the final.

sentences.zh: 即各得其星其段初、末日行度及分秒。

translations.literal: Each thereby obtains that planet's segment initial and final day motion degrees and parts seconds.
translations.idiomatic: Each procedure thereby yields that planet's initial and final daily motion in degrees, parts, and seconds.

sentences.zh: 凡前後段平行分俱多或俱少，乃平注之；

translations.literal: Whenever anterior and posterior segments' mean motion parts are both greater or both fewer, then level and apply evenly;
translations.idiomatic: When both adjacent segments have greater or smaller mean motion, distribute the correction evenly;

sentences.zh: 及本段總差不滿大分者，亦平注之。

translations.literal: and when this segment's total difference does not fill major parts, also level and apply evenly.
translations.idiomatic: and when the segment's total difference does not reach a major part, likewise distribute evenly.

sentences.zh: 其退行段，各以半總差前變減之為初，加之為末；

translations.literal: For retrograde segments, each with half the total difference from the anterior phase subtract for initial and add for final;
translations.idiomatic: For retrograde segments, take half the total difference from the anterior phase, subtract for the initial day and add for the final;

sentences.zh: 後變加之為初，減之為末。

translations.literal: for the posterior phase add for initial and subtract for final.
translations.idiomatic: for the following phase add for the initial day and subtract for the final.

sentences.zh: 求每日晨前夜半星行宿次：置其段總差，減其段日率，以除之，為日差；

translations.literal: To find each day's pre-dawn midnight star-motion lodge position: set its segment total difference; subtract its segment day rate; divide by it — that is the day difference;
translations.idiomatic: To find the star's lodge at pre-dawn midnight for each day: set the segment total difference, subtract the segment day rate, and divide — yielding the daily difference;

sentences.zh: 以日差累損益初日行分，後段行分少，日損之；

translations.literal: with the day difference cumulatively damage-benefit the initial-day motion parts; if the next segment's motion parts are fewer, daily subtract;
translations.idiomatic: apply the daily difference cumulatively to the initial-day motion — if the next segment's motion is smaller, subtract daily;

sentences.zh: 後段行分多，日益之。

translations.literal: if the next segment's motion parts are greater, daily add.
translations.idiomatic: if the next segment's motion is greater, add daily.

sentences.zh: 為每日行度及分；

translations.literal: that is each day's motion degrees and parts;
translations.idiomatic: This yields each day's motion in degrees and parts;

sentences.zh: 以每日行度及分累加其星其段初日晨前夜半宿次，命之，即每日星行宿次。

translations.literal: with each day's motion degrees and parts cumulatively add to that planet's segment initial-day pre-dawn midnight lodge position; count — that is each day's star-motion lodge position.
translations.idiomatic: accumulate each day's motion degrees and parts from the segment's initial pre-dawn midnight lodge and count — thereby obtaining the star's lodge for each day.

sentences.zh: 遇退行者，以每日行分累減之，即得所求。

translations.literal: When encountering retrograde motion, with each day's motion parts cumulatively subtract — thereby obtaining what is sought.
translations.idiomatic: For retrograde motion, accumulate by subtracting each day's motion parts — thereby obtaining the desired result.

sentences.zh: 徑求其日宿次：置所求日，減一，日差乘之，加減初日行分，後行分少，即減之；

translations.literal: To find directly that day's lodge position: set the day sought; subtract 1; multiply by the day difference; add or subtract to the initial-day motion parts; if the next motion parts are fewer, then subtract;
translations.idiomatic: To find a given day's lodge directly: set the day sought, subtract 1, multiply by the daily difference, and add or subtract from the initial-day motion — subtract if the next segment's motion is smaller;

sentences.zh: 後行分多，即加之。

translations.literal: if the next motion parts are greater, then add.
translations.idiomatic: add if the next segment's motion is greater.

sentences.zh: 為所求日行分；

translations.literal: that is the day sought's daily motion parts;
translations.idiomatic: This yields the sought day's daily motion parts;

sentences.zh: 加日行分而半之；

translations.literal: add the daily motion parts and halve;
translations.idiomatic: add the daily motion parts and halve the sum;

sentences.zh: 以所求日乘之，為徑求積度；

translations.literal: multiply by the day sought — that is the direct-seek accumulated degrees;
translations.idiomatic: multiply by the day sought to obtain the direct accumulated degrees;

sentences.zh: 加減其星初日宿次；

translations.literal: add or subtract to that planet's initial-day lodge position;
translations.idiomatic: add or subtract from that planet's initial-day lodge position;

sentences.zh: 命之，即其日星行宿次。

translations.literal: count — that is that day's star-motion lodge position.
translations.idiomatic: count the lodges — thereby obtaining that day's star position.

sentences.zh: 求五星定合日定星：以其星平合初日行分減一百分，餘以約其日太陽盈縮分為分，分滿百為日，不滿為分，命為距合差日；

translations.literal: To find the five planets' fixed conjunction day and fixed star: with that planet's mean-conjunction initial-day motion parts subtract 100 parts; the remainder contract that day's solar excess-deficit parts for parts; when parts fill 100 they become days, what does not fill is parts — count as conjunction-distance difference day;
translations.idiomatic: To find the fixed conjunction day and star for each planet: subtract 100 parts from the mean-conjunction initial-day motion, use the remainder to contract that day's solar excess-deficit parts, promote every 100 parts to a day — this is the conjunction-distance difference day;

sentences.zh: 以盈縮分減之，為距合差度；

translations.literal: subtract the excess-deficit parts — that is the conjunction-distance difference degrees.
translations.idiomatic: subtract the excess-deficit parts to obtain the conjunction-distance difference in degrees.

sentences.zh: 以差日、差度縮加盈減平合定積、定星，為其星定合日定積、定星。

translations.literal: With the difference day and difference degrees, deficit-add and excess-subtract to the mean-conjunction fixed accumulation and fixed star — that is that planet's fixed conjunction day, fixed accumulation, and fixed star.
translations.idiomatic: Apply the difference day and difference degrees, adding when in deficit and subtracting when in excess to the mean-conjunction fixed accumulation and fixed star — thereby obtaining the planet's fixed conjunction day, accumulation, and star.

sentences.zh: 其金、水二星，以一百分減初日行分，餘以除其日太陽盈縮分，為距合差日；

translations.literal: For Venus and Mercury, subtract 100 parts from the initial-day motion parts; the remainder divide that day's solar excess-deficit parts — that is the conjunction-distance difference day;
translations.idiomatic: For Venus and Mercury, subtract 100 parts from the initial-day motion and divide that day's solar excess-deficit parts by the remainder — yielding the conjunction-distance difference day;

sentences.zh: 以盈縮分加之，為距合差度；

translations.literal: add the excess-deficit parts — that is the conjunction-distance difference degrees.
translations.idiomatic: add the excess-deficit parts to obtain the conjunction-distance difference in degrees.

sentences.zh: 以差日、差度盈加縮減之。

translations.literal: With the difference day and difference degrees, excess-add and deficit-subtract.
translations.idiomatic: Apply the difference day and degrees, adding when in excess and subtracting when in deficit.

sentences.zh: 金、水二星退合者，以初日行分加一百分，以除太陽盈縮分，為距合差日；

translations.literal: For Venus and Mercury in retrograde conjunction, add 100 parts to the initial-day motion parts and divide the solar excess-deficit parts — that is the conjunction-distance difference day;
translations.idiomatic: For Venus and Mercury in retrograde conjunction, add 100 parts to the initial-day motion and divide the solar excess-deficit parts — yielding the conjunction-distance difference day;

sentences.zh: 以距合差日減盈縮分，為距合差度；

translations.literal: subtract the excess-deficit parts by the conjunction-distance difference day — that is the conjunction-distance difference degrees.
translations.idiomatic: subtract the conjunction-distance difference day from the excess-deficit parts to obtain the conjunction-distance difference in degrees.

sentences.zh: 以差日、差度盈減縮加再合定積定星為其星再合定日定積定星。

translations.literal: With the difference day and difference degrees, excess-subtract and deficit-add to the second-conjunction fixed accumulation and fixed star — that is that planet's second-conjunction fixed day, fixed accumulation, and fixed star.
translations.idiomatic: Apply the difference day and degrees, subtracting when in excess and adding when in deficit to the second-conjunction fixed accumulation and star — thereby obtaining the planet's second-conjunction fixed day, accumulation, and star.

sentences.zh: 其金、水二星定積，各依見伏術，先以盈縮差求其加減訖，然後以距合差日、差度加減之。

translations.literal: For Venus and Mercury fixed accumulations, each follows the visibility-occultation procedure; first use the excess-deficit difference to find its additions and subtractions complete, then with the conjunction-distance difference day and difference degrees add or subtract.
translations.idiomatic: For the fixed accumulations of Venus and Mercury, follow the visibility-occultation procedure: first complete the excess-deficit corrections, then apply the conjunction-distance difference day and degrees.

sentences.zh: 求木火土三星晨見夕伏定日：各置其星其段定積，乃加減一象度，晨見加之，夕伏減之。

translations.literal: To find Jupiter, Mars, and Saturn morning visibility and evening occultation fixed days: each set that planet's segment fixed accumulation; then add or subtract one image degree — for morning visibility add, for evening occultation subtract.
translations.idiomatic: To find the fixed days of morning visibility and evening occultation for Jupiter, Mars, and Saturn: set each segment's fixed accumulation, then add or subtract one image degree — adding for morning visibility and subtracting for evening occultation.

sentences.zh: 半周天已下自相乘，半周天已上，覆減周天度及分，餘亦自相乘，一百約為分，以其星伏見度乘之，十五除之，為差；

translations.literal: At or below half a circuit of heaven self-multiply; at or above half a circuit of heaven, overlay-subtract the circuit-of-heaven degrees and parts, the remainder also self-multiply; contract by 100 for parts; multiply by that planet's occultation-visibility degrees; divide by 15 — that is the difference;
translations.idiomatic: Below half a celestial circuit, square the value; above half a circuit, subtract from the full circuit degrees and square the remainder; contract by 100, multiply by the planet's occultation-visibility degrees, and divide by 15 — yielding the correction;

sentences.zh: 乃以其段初日行分覆減一百分，餘以除其差為日，不滿，退除為分，所得，以加減定積，晨見加之，夕伏減之。

translations.literal: Then with that segment's initial-day motion parts overlay-subtract 100 parts; the remainder divide the difference for days; what does not fill, retreat-divide for parts; what is obtained use to add or subtract the fixed accumulation — morning visibility add, evening occultation subtract.
translations.idiomatic: Subtract 100 parts from the segment's initial-day motion in overlay fashion, divide the difference by the remainder for days and parts, and apply to the fixed accumulation — adding for morning visibility and subtracting for evening occultation.

sentences.zh: 各得晨見、夕伏定積；

translations.literal: each obtains morning visibility and evening occultation fixed accumulations;
translations.idiomatic: Each thereby obtains the fixed accumulation for morning visibility and evening occultation;

sentences.zh: 加天正冬至大餘及分，命甲子，算外，即得日辰。

translations.literal: add the civil winter-solstice major remainder and parts; count from jiazi, outside the count — thereby obtaining the day and double-hour.
translations.idiomatic: add the civil winter-solstice major remainder and parts, count from jiazi exclusive, and obtain the day and double-hour.

sentences.zh: 求金水二星夕見晨伏定日：各置其星其段定積，其定積先倍其段盈縮差，縮加盈減之，乃加減一象度，夕見減之，晨伏加之。

translations.literal: To find Venus and Mercury evening visibility and morning occultation fixed days: each set that planet's segment fixed accumulation; the fixed accumulation first doubles that segment's excess-deficit difference, deficit-add and excess-subtract; then add or subtract one image degree — evening visibility subtract, morning occultation add.
translations.idiomatic: To find the fixed days of evening visibility and morning occultation for Venus and Mercury: set each segment's fixed accumulation, double the segment's excess-deficit difference and apply it, then add or subtract one image degree — subtracting for evening visibility and adding for morning occultation.

sentences.zh: 半周天已下自相乘，已上，覆減周天度，餘亦自相乘，一百約為分，以其星伏見度乘之，十五除為差；

translations.literal: At or below half a circuit of heaven self-multiply; above, overlay-subtract the circuit-of-heaven degrees, the remainder also self-multiply; contract by 100 for parts; multiply by that planet's occultation-visibility degrees; divide by 15 for the difference;
translations.idiomatic: Below half a celestial circuit, square the value; above, subtract from the full circuit and square the remainder; contract by 100, multiply by the planet's occultation-visibility degrees, and divide by 15 for the correction;

sentences.zh: 乃置其段初日行分，減去一百分，餘以除其差為日，不滿，退除為分，所得，以加減定積，夕見加之，晨伏減之。

translations.literal: Then set that segment's initial-day motion parts; subtract 100 parts; the remainder divide the difference for days; what does not fill, retreat-divide for parts; what is obtained use to add or subtract the fixed accumulation — evening visibility add, morning occultation subtract.
translations.idiomatic: Set the segment's initial-day motion, subtract 100 parts, divide the difference by the remainder for days and parts, and apply to the fixed accumulation — adding for evening visibility and subtracting for morning occultation.

sentences.zh: 各得夕見、晨伏定積。

translations.literal: Each obtains evening visibility and morning occultation fixed accumulations.
translations.idiomatic: Each thereby obtains the fixed accumulation for evening visibility and morning occultation.

sentences.zh: 求金水二星晨見夕伏定日：置其星其段定積，其定積先以一百乘其段盈縮差，乃以一百分加其日行分，以除其差，所得，盈加縮減之，加減一象度，晨見加之，夕伏減之。

translations.literal: To find Venus and Mercury morning visibility and evening occultation fixed days: set that planet's segment fixed accumulation; the fixed accumulation first multiplies that segment's excess-deficit difference by 100; then add 100 parts to its daily motion parts and divide the difference; what is obtained, excess-add and deficit-subtract; add or subtract one image degree — morning visibility add, evening occultation subtract.
translations.idiomatic: To find the fixed days of morning visibility and evening occultation for Venus and Mercury: set the segment's fixed accumulation, multiply its excess-deficit difference by 100, add 100 parts to the daily motion and divide the difference, apply excess-add and deficit-subtract, then add or subtract one image degree — adding for morning visibility and subtracting for evening occultation.

sentences.zh: 半周天已下自相乘，已上，覆減周天度，餘亦自相乘，一百約為分，以其星伏見度乘之，十五除，為差；

translations.literal: Then set that segment's initial-day motion parts as 100; divide the difference for days; what does not fill, retreat-divide for parts; what is obtained use to add or subtract the fixed accumulation — morning visibility add, evening occultation subtract.
translations.idiomatic: Set the segment's initial-day motion equal to 100, divide the difference for days and parts, and apply to the fixed accumulation — adding for morning visibility and subtracting for evening occultation.

sentences.zh: 各為其星晨見、夕伏定積。

translations.literal: Each is that planet's morning visibility and evening occultation fixed accumulation.
translations.idiomatic: Each thereby yields that planet's fixed accumulation for morning visibility and evening occultation.

sentences.zh: 曆既成，以來年甲子歲用之，是年五月丁亥朔，日食不效，算食二分半，候之不食。

translations.literal: When the calendar was completed, it was put into use in the following jiazi year; that year on the new moon of the fifth month, dinghai day, the solar eclipse did not occur as predicted — the calculation showed an eclipse of two and a half tenths, but when observed, there was no eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Once the calendar was completed it was adopted for the following jiazi year; on the fifth-month dinghai new moon that year the predicted solar eclipse failed to occur — the calculation called for a magnitude of two and a half tenths, yet observation showed no eclipse.

sentences.zh: 詔候驗。

translations.literal: An edict ordered observation and verification.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered observational verification.

sentences.zh: 至七年，命入內都知江德明集曆官用渾儀較測。

translations.literal: By the seventh year, the Palace Duty Officer Jiang Deming was ordered to assemble the calendar officials to compare and measure with the armillary sphere.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, the Palace Duty Officer Jiang Deming was ordered to assemble the calendar officials for comparative measurement with the armillary sphere.

translations.idiomatic: Circuit-of-heaven parts: 3,868,066, seconds 17.

translations.idiomatic: Void parts 2,716, seconds 17; contracted parts 25, seconds 61.
